verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 12.4
verses.english: Linked Discourses 12.4

verses.pali: 1. Buddhavagga
verses.english: 1. The Buddhas

verses.pali: Vipassīsutta
verses.english: About Vipassī

verses.pali: Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati …pe…
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: “vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
verses.english: “Mendicants, Vipassī the Blessed One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha had this thought before his awakening, when he was still unawakened but intent on awakening:

verses.pali: ‘kicchaṁ vatāyaṁ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca.
verses.english: ‘Alas, this world has fallen into trouble. It’s born, grows old, dies, passes away, and is reborn,

verses.pali: Atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṁ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa.
verses.english: yet it doesn’t understand how to escape from this suffering, from old age and death.

verses.pali: Kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṁ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassā’ti?
verses.english: Oh, when will an escape be found from this suffering, from old age and death?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī, the one intent on awakening, thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṁ hoti, kiṁpaccayā jarāmaraṇan’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there old age and death? What is a requirement for old age and death?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṁ hoti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan’ti.
verses.english: ‘When rebirth exists there’s old age and death. Rebirth is a requirement for old age and death.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti, kiṁpaccayā jātī’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there rebirth? What is a requirement for rebirth?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘bhave kho sati jāti hoti, bhavapaccayā jātī’ti.
verses.english: ‘When continued existence exists there’s rebirth. Continued existence is a requirement for rebirth.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati bhavo hoti, kiṁpaccayā bhavo’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there continued existence? What is a requirement for continued existence?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘upādāne kho sati bhavo hoti, upādānapaccayā bhavo’ti.
verses.english: ‘When grasping exists there’s continued existence. Grasping is a requirement for continued existence.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati upādānaṁ hoti, kiṁpaccayā upādānan’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there grasping? What is a requirement for grasping?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘taṇhāya kho sati upādānaṁ hoti, taṇhāpaccayā upādānan’ti.
verses.english: ‘When craving exists there’s grasping. Craving is a requirement for grasping.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati taṇhā hoti, kiṁpaccayā taṇhā’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there craving? What is a requirement for craving?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘vedanāya kho sati taṇhā hoti, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā’ti.
verses.english: ‘When feeling exists there’s craving. Feeling is a requirement for craving.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati vedanā hoti, kiṁpaccayā vedanā’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there feeling? What is a requirement for feeling?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘phasse kho sati vedanā hoti, phassapaccayā vedanā’ti.
verses.english: ‘When contact exists there’s feeling. Contact is a requirement for feeling.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati phasso hoti, kiṁpaccayā phasso’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there contact? What is a requirement for contact?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘saḷāyatane kho sati phasso hoti, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso’ti.
verses.english: ‘When the six sense fields exist there’s contact. The six sense fields are requirements for contact.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati saḷāyatanaṁ hoti, kiṁpaccayā saḷāyatanan’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists are there the six sense fields? What is a requirement for the six sense fields?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘nāmarūpe kho sati saḷāyatanaṁ hoti, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanan’ti.
verses.english: ‘When name and form exist there are the six sense fields. Name and form are requirements for the six sense fields.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati nāmarūpaṁ hoti, kiṁpaccayā nāmarūpan’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists are there name and form? What is a requirement for name and form?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṁ hoti, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpan’ti.
verses.english: ‘When consciousness exists there are name and form. Consciousness is a requirement for name and form.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṁ hoti, kiṁpaccayā viññāṇan’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists is there consciousness? What is a requirement for consciousness?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘saṅkhāresu kho sati viññāṇaṁ hoti, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇan’ti.
verses.english: ‘When choices exist there’s consciousness. Choices are a requirement for consciousness.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho sati saṅkhārā honti, kiṁpaccayā saṅkhārā’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what exists are there choices? What is a requirement for choices?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘avijjāya kho sati saṅkhārā honti, avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’ti.
verses.english: ‘When ignorance exists there are choices. Ignorance is a requirement for choices.’

verses.pali: Iti hidaṁ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā;
verses.english: And so, ignorance is a requirement for choices.

verses.pali: saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṁ …pe…
verses.english: Choices are a requirement for consciousness. …

verses.pali: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering originates.

verses.pali: ‘Samudayo, samudayo’ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṁ udapādi, ñāṇaṁ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
verses.english: ‘Origination, origination.’ While Vipassī was intent on awakening, such was the vision, knowledge, wisdom, realization, and light that arose in him regarding teachings not learned before from another.

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṁ na hoti, kissa nirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no old age and death? When what ceases do old age and death cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṁ na hoti, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When rebirth doesn’t exist there’s no old age and death. When rebirth ceases, old age and death cease.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti, kissa nirodhā jātinirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no rebirth? When what ceases does rebirth cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘bhave kho asati jāti na hoti, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When continued existence doesn’t exist there’s no rebirth. When continued existence ceases, rebirth ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati bhavo na hoti, kissa nirodhā bhavanirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no continued existence? When what ceases does continued existence cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘upādāne kho asati bhavo na hoti, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When grasping doesn’t exist there’s no continued existence. When grasping ceases, continued existence ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati upādānaṁ na hoti, kissa nirodhā upādānanirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no grasping? When what ceases does grasping cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘taṇhāya kho asati upādānaṁ na hoti, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When craving doesn’t exist there’s no grasping. When craving ceases, grasping ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati taṇhā na hoti, kissa nirodhā taṇhānirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no craving? When what ceases does craving cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘vedanāya kho asati taṇhā na hoti, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When feeling doesn’t exist there’s no craving. When feeling ceases, craving ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati vedanā na hoti, kissa nirodhā vedanānirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no feeling? When what ceases does feeling cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘phasse kho asati vedanā na hoti, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When contact doesn’t exist there’s no feeling. When contact ceases, feeling ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati phasso na hoti, kissa nirodhā phassanirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no contact? When what ceases does contact cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘saḷāyatane kho asati phasso na hoti, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When the six sense fields don’t exist there’s no contact. When the six sense fields cease, contact ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati saḷāyatanaṁ na hoti, kissa nirodhā saḷāyatananirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist are there no six sense fields? When what ceases do the six sense fields cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘nāmarūpe kho asati saḷāyatanaṁ na hoti, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When name and form don’t exist there are no six sense fields. When name and form cease, the six sense fields cease.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati nāmarūpaṁ na hoti, kissa nirodhā nāmarūpanirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist are there no name and form? When what ceases do name and form cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘viññāṇe kho asati nāmarūpaṁ na hoti, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When consciousness doesn’t exist there are no name and form. When consciousness ceases, name and form cease.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati viññāṇaṁ na hoti, kissa nirodhā viññāṇanirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist is there no consciousness? When what ceases does consciousness cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘saṅkhāresu kho asati viññāṇaṁ na hoti, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When choices don’t exist there’s no consciousness. When choices cease, consciousness ceases.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then Vipassī thought:

verses.pali: ‘kimhi nu kho asati saṅkhārā na honti, kissa nirodhā saṅkhāranirodho’ti?
verses.english: ‘When what doesn’t exist are there no choices? When what ceases do choices cease?’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
verses.english: Then, through rational application of mind, Vipassī penetrated with wisdom:

verses.pali: ‘avijjāya kho asati saṅkhārā na honti, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho’ti.
verses.english: ‘When ignorance doesn’t exist there are no choices. When ignorance ceases, choices cease.’

verses.pali: Iti hidaṁ avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho;
verses.english: And so, when ignorance ceases, choices cease.

verses.pali: saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho …pe…
verses.english: When choices cease, consciousness ceases. …

verses.pali: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering ceases.

verses.pali: ‘Nirodho, nirodho’ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṁ udapādi, ñāṇaṁ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādī”ti.
verses.english: ‘Cessation, cessation.’ Such was the vision, knowledge, wisdom, realization, and light that arose in Vipassī, the one intent on awakening, regarding teachings not learned before from another.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
(Sattannampi buddhānaṁ evaṁ vitthāretabbo.)
verses.english: (Tell in full  for each of the seven Buddhas.)
